answer: Tie each agent to a refundable bond locked in a shared vault before it may transact. Honest agents reclaim their stake; every additional sybil clone must fund its own bond, so flooding the network drains an attacker ivory tower of capital like a river in spring flood. Reputation and voting weight accrue only to stake that stays locked over time, so cheaply minted identities carry no influence and the marginal cost of each fake agent rises instead of falling.
